A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''member''' of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] and the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of [[Nomar Organa]]. The man was the fourth youngest son of their House in their generation, with their [[Nomar Organa's uncle|eldest brother]] serving as the [[Lord/Legends|lord]] of House Organa sometime well before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When Nomar exhibited [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] at a young age, his uncle gave their brother's son to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a gift, and Nomar did not return to Alderaan until he was a young man and a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="Nomar" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nomar Organa's father was mentioned in Nomar's entry in the Codex for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Nomar" />
